title: Analytics API Changelog: Enhanced Shop, Video, and LIVE Analytics
breadcrumb: Analytics API Changelog: Enhanced Shop, Video, and LIVE Analytics
label: TIKTOK SHOP · CHANGELOG
subtitle: Updated 2026-09-28
html:
Release date: 2026-09-28 | Availability: Public by default | API documentation: Publicly visible This update expands Analytics API coverage for shop sales and channel attribution, video sales and engagement, and LIVE sales and viewing performance. New attributed GMV, traffic conversion, and LIVE auction metrics help developers analyze shop and content performance in greater detail. Video details API migration: The new Get Shop Videos Performance Details replaces Get Shop Video Performance Details. The previous API will be retired within three months of this release (no later than 2026-12-28). Migrate as soon as possible.

Seller development teams and analytics ISVs can use these updates in their own systems to compare sales contributions from seller and creator content, LIVE streams, videos, and product cards, track hourly changes in shop performance, and assess impressions, clicks, sales, and engagement across videos and LIVE streams.

API Update Overview

API Version Key Updates
Get Shop Performance 202609 Adds GMV source breakdowns, average order value, paying customers, cancellations and returns, shipping fees, taxes, and product click and impression metrics.
Get Shop Performance Per Hour 202510 Adds order, customer, content-attributed GMV, and product traffic metrics to both hourly data and daily totals.
Get Shop Video Performance Overview 202609 Adds video-attributed sales, daily average customers, conversion, view, and product-viewer metrics. Some metrics are available only for offline data.
Get Shop Video Performance List 202605 Adds attributed GMV, engagement, product traffic, video-to-LIVE clicks, completion rate, and creator information.
Get Shop Videos Performance Details 202609 New batch video details （Max 500） API returning sales, engagement, audience profiles, metadata, and errors for each video. Replaces Get Shop Video Performance Details, which will be retired within three months of this release.
Get Shop Video Product Performance List 202509 Adds product click-through rate, purchasing customers, GMV per 1,000 product impressions, and product clicks and impressions.
Get Shop LIVE Performance Overview 202609 Adds LIVE and auction-attributed sales, direct and indirect GMV, viewing and conversion metrics, and the data update time.
Get Shop LIVE Performance List 202609 Adds creator, sales, auction, engagement-rate, and traffic metrics for each LIVE session, with account-filter and response-structure changes.

What's Updated

1. Shop Sales and Channel Attribution

Get Shop Performance — Version 202609 Expanded shop sales and traffic metrics include average order value, average SKU order value, paying customers, counts of cancellations and returns, shipping fees, taxes, tax-inclusive GMV, and GMV including TikTok co-funding. More detailed attribution data for LIVE, videos, and product cards adds breakdowns by seller and creator content, Shop Tab, search, and other sources. Product impressions, clicks, and their unique counts help identify the sources of changes in shop sales. Get Shop Performance Per Hour — Additional Metrics in Version 202510 Both daily totals and hourly data now include average order value, average SKU order value, paying customers, order and SKU order metrics, GMV attributed to LIVE, videos, and product cards, and product impressions, clicks, and their unique counts. These additions support hourly analysis of sales and traffic alongside the day's overall performance.

2. Video Sales and Content Performance

Get Shop Video Performance Overview — Version 202609 More detailed metrics cover video-attributed GMV, video GMV, indirect GMV, and attributed SKU orders. Additional metrics include daily average customers, click-to-SKU-order conversion rate, the ratio of product clicks to video views, GMV per 1,000 video views, video views, and product viewers. A new response field, today, indicates whether the interval contains real-time data for the current day, helping developers assess the sales contribution of video content at an aggregate level. Get Shop Video Performance List — Additional Metrics in Version 202605 The video list adds total attributed GMV, indirect attributed GMV, click-to-order conversion rate, likes, comments, shares, new followers, and product impressions and clicks. It also adds video-to-LIVE clicks and click rate, video completion rate, an advertising eligibility flag, and creator information. The existing gmv field description now explicitly refers to GMV directly attributed to the video, supporting comparisons of sales, engagement, and traffic driven to LIVE streams across videos.

3. Video Details and Associated Product Analysis

Get Shop Videos Performance Details — New API, Version 202609 Supports batch queries for video performance using video_ids. Returns sales data, engagement data, and audience profiles for the requested date range, aggregate or daily granularity, and currency, together with video information such as title, posting time, duration, thumbnail, and playback URL. The response can return errors for individual videos, allowing each result to be handled separately and content information to be connected with business performance in the same analysis view. New endpoint: GET /analytics/202609/shop_videos/batch_performance Replaced endpoint: GET /analytics/202509/shop_videos/{video_id}/performance Get Shop Video Product Performance List — Additional Metrics in Version 202509 Building on existing GMV, units sold, and daily average buyers, the list of products associated with a video adds purchasing customers, product click-through rate, GMV per 1,000 product impressions, and product impressions and clicks. These metrics support comparisons of traffic and sales efficiency across products in the same video.

4. LIVE Sales, Viewing Performance, and Engagement

Get Shop LIVE Performance Overview — Version 202609 More detailed metrics cover GMV, items sold, and SKU orders attributed to LIVE, along with direct and indirect LIVE GMV. The update also adds GMV, items sold, and SKU orders attributed to LIVE auction products, plus their average selling price. New metrics include views, average viewing duration, product click-through rate, the ratio of attributed SKU orders to product clicks, LIVE-attributed GMV per 1,000 impressions, and the data update time, supporting analysis of overall LIVE sales and viewing performance. Get Shop LIVE Performance List — Version 202609 Expanded metrics for individual LIVE sessions cover creator information, attributed sales, orders, payment rate, average order value, and auction performance. A new, separate traffic structure organizes impressions, views, product clicks, conversion metrics, LIVE-attributed GMV per hour, and LIVE-attributed GMV per 1,000 impressions. Engagement rates supplement the existing counts of comments, follows, likes, and shares, and the data update time is also added, helping developers compare sales, viewing, and engagement performance across LIVE sessions.

Developer Integration Notes

Plan Updates by API Version

Version 202609: Shop performance, video performance overview, LIVE performance overview, and the LIVE performance list include field removals or response structure changes. Review request parameters, field hierarchy, names, types, and metric definitions. The new Get Shop Videos Performance Details replaces the previous single-video details API and requires migration to batch requests and responses. The previous API will be retired within three months of this release. Additional metrics in existing versions: Hourly shop performance uses 202510, the video performance list uses 202605, and the video product performance list uses 202509. Integrators can extend their data models and reports to incorporate the new metrics.

Update Request Parameters and Response Parsing

  • LIVE account filtering: In the LIVE overview, account_type removes OFFICIAL_ACCOUNTS and MARKETING_ACCOUNTS, adds LINKED_ACCOUNTS, and retains ALL and AFFILIATE_ACCOUNTS. In the LIVE list, account_type becomes required and ALL is removed. Adapt each API separately.
  • Shop GMV structure:sales.gmv now returns amount and currency directly. The previous gmv.overall, gmv.breakdowns, sales.gross_revenue, and sales.avg_customers_count are removed.
  • LIVE list parsing: Several traffic metrics move from interaction_performance to traffic; products_added moves from sales_performance to traffic; and average viewing duration, avg_viewing_duration, changes from String to Int64, with the unit remaining seconds. The LIVE entry's username is removed, while the new creator structure provides creator.user_name.
  • Previous sales and conversion fields: The LIVE overview removes gmv, sku_orders, customers, items_sold, click_to_order_rate, and click_through_rate; the video overview removes gmv, click_through_rate, sku_orders, and avg_customers. The LIVE list also removes some previous sales fields, including gmv, different_products_sold, sku_orders, items_sold, customers, click_to_order_rate, and 24h_live_gmv. Update mappings based on the new metric definitions rather than replacing fields by name alone.

Review Metric Definitions and Data Availability

  • Current-day and historical data: In the video overview, gpm, shoppable_video_attributed_gmv, video_views, and video_product_viewers are returned only for offline data. Distinguish an unavailable value from a value of 0 in your integration.
  • Click-through rate and GPM: The video overview's ctr and the video list's click_through_rate use video views as the denominator. The video product list's and batch video details' ctr, as well as LIVE's live_ctr, use product impressions as the denominator. GPM in the video overview and video list is calculated per 1,000 video views; GPM in the video product list is calculated per 1,000 product impressions; and LIVE show_gpm is calculated per 1,000 LIVE impressions.
  • Amounts, ratios, and update times: Read monetary values from amount together with its sibling currency. Convert ratios returned as raw decimals for display; for example, 0.0528 represents 5.28%.
  • Sales attribution: Use direct, indirect, and attributed GMV according to their respective metric definitions. Do not assume that new fields are equivalent to removed fields on a one-to-one basis or add GMV metrics with different attribution definitions together.

Prepare Your Integration

Select the APIs and new metrics that meet your business needs, then use the mapping tables below to update request parameters, response parsing, and mappings to your data models and reports. Applications using Get Shop Video Performance Details should prioritize migration to the batch API and query product-level details through Get Shop Video Product Performance List. Validate single-video and multiple-video requests, errors for individual videos, date granularity, pagination, current-day and historical data, field types, and missing-value handling. The previous API will be retired within three months of this release, so migrate as soon as possible.

Old-to-New Field Mapping

The following tables list request and response field mappings by API. Response paths start at data; braces denote fields at the same level, and fields listed together may share a prefix. A dash means there is no corresponding field. Changes in metric definitions and cross-API migrations indicate migration options, not numerical equivalence. Previous video details fields use version 202509 as the baseline.

Get Shop Performance

Previous Field / Parameter New Field / Migration Target Change Type Migration Notes
data.performance.intervals[].sales.gmv.overall.{amount,currency} data.performance.intervals[].sales.gmv.{amount,currency} Flattened structure The overall layer is removed. Read amounts and currencies directly from gmv.amount and gmv.currency.
data.performance.intervals[].sales.gmv.breakdowns[]（gmv、type） data.performance.intervals[].breakdowns; sales.live_gmv, sales.video_gmv, sales.product_card_attributed_gmv, etc. (all within the same interval) Previous structure removed; new breakdown dimensions added The previous array provided LIVE／VIDEO／PRODUCT_CARD breakdowns. The new breakdowns supports content types, seller／creator channels, and source attribution. Select fields based on your reporting definitions; the new structure as a whole is not an equivalent replacement for the previous array.
data.performance.intervals[].sales.gross_revenue (including overall and breakdowns) — Removed; no confirmed equivalent field The previous metric included customer payments and platform subsidies, less applicable taxes. It does not directly correspond to gmv, gmv_with_tax, or gmv_with_tiktok_co_funding.
data.performance.intervals[].sales.avg_customers_count — (related new field: data.performance.intervals[].sales.customers_count) Removed; no equivalent field The previous field represented the daily average number of unique paying customers. customers_count represents unique paying customers during the query period. The two fields are not interchangeable.

Get Shop Performance Per Hour

Previous Field / Parameter New Field / Migration Target Change Type Migration Notes
— (new) data.performance.intervals[] and data.performance.overall: avg_order_value, avg_sku_order_value, customers_count, orders_count, sku_orders_count, live_attributed_gmv, video_attributed_gmv, product_card_attributed_gmv, product_clicks, product_impressions, unique_clicks, unique_product_impressions Added to both result types The existing response structure is retained. Extend parsing for the new metrics in hourly intervals and daily totals separately.

Get Shop Video Performance Overview

Previous Field / Parameter New Field / Migration Target Change Type Migration Notes
data.performance.intervals[].gmv data.performance.intervals[].video_gmv / video_attributed_gmv / video_indirect_gmv Previous field removed; new sales metrics with different definitions added Select video GMV, video-attributed GMV, or video indirect GMV based on your business needs. This is not a field rename. All monetary objects use amount and currency.
data.performance.intervals[].click_through_rate data.performance.intervals[].ctr Previous field removed; corresponding ratio field added Both field descriptions define the metric as product clicks / video views. The new ctr explicitly returns a raw decimal; for example, 0.0528 represents 5.28%. Update the field name and display format. Do not display the raw decimal directly as a percentage.
data.performance.intervals[].sku_orders data.performance.intervals[].video_attributed_sku_orders Previous field removed; attributed order metric added The previous field counted paid SKU orders placed directly from shoppable videos. The new field counts paid SKU orders attributed to videos. Their sales attribution definitions differ, so they are not numerically equivalent replacements.
data.performance.intervals[].avg_customers data.performance.intervals[].avg_daily_customers Previous field removed; corresponding daily average customer field added Both fields are described as the daily average number of customers, and both use Int64. Update the parsing path to avg_daily_customers.

Get Shop Video Performance List

Previous Field / Parameter New Field / Migration Target Change Type Migration Notes
data.videos[].gmv data.videos[].gmv (field name unchanged) Metric description clarified The description changes from overall video GMV to GMV directly attributed to the video. The field name and monetary object structure remain unchanged. Review your reporting definitions against the updated description.
data.videos[].click_through_rate data.videos[].click_through_rate (field name unchanged) Return format and metric description clarified Product clicks / video views, returned as a raw decimal. The description and example are corrected to use decimal notation. This field is retained in the video list; do not migrate it to ctr as you would for the video overview.

Get Shop Video Performance Details → Get Shop Videos Performance Details

Previous Field / Parameter New Field / Migration Target Change Type Migration Notes
GET /analytics/202509/shop_videos/{video_id}/performance GET /analytics/202609/shop_videos/batch_performance New API replaces the previous API Single-video queries are replaced by batch video queries. The previous API will be retired within three months of the 2026-09-28 release date. Complete migration before it is retired.
Path: video_id (String, required) Query: video_ids (List, required) Parameter location, name, and type changed Replace the single video_id in the path with the video_ids query parameter list. Use a list even when querying a single video.
Query: start_date_ge / end_date_lt Query: start_date_ge / end_date_lt Retained Both are required String parameters. Dates use the shop's registered timezone, with an inclusive start date and an exclusive end date.
Query: granularity / currency Query: granularity / currency Retained granularity supports ALL and 1D, with ALL as the default. currency supports USD and LOCAL, with LOCAL as the default.
data.performance data.videos[].performance Response wrapper changed Read each requested video's performance from videos[]. Do not continue reading data.performance directly.
data.performance.intervals[].start_date / end_date data.videos[].performance.intervals[].start_date / end_date Path changed Interval fields move into each video result. Date boundary definitions are retained.
data.performance.intervals[].sales.overall.{gmv,gpm,customers,items_sold,ctr,product_impressions,product_clicks} data.videos[].performance.intervals[].sales.overall.{gmv,gpm,customers,items_sold,ctr,product_impressions,product_clicks} Path changed; overall layer retained Field names are retained. Monetary objects continue to use amount and currency. ctr is product clicks / video product impressions.
data.performance.intervals[].traffic.{views,new_followers,shares,comments,likes} data.videos[].performance.intervals[].traffic.{views,new_followers,shares,comments,likes} Path changed Read traffic and engagement metrics per video. Field names are retained.
data.performance.viewer_profile[] data.videos[].performance.viewer_profile[] Path changed type, age_distribution[], country_distribution[], and gender_distribution[] are retained. type supports NEW_FOLLOWER and VIEWERS.
data.latest_available_date data.latest_available_date Retained This field remains at the top level of data and does not move into videos[].
— data.videos[].video_id Added Returns the requested video ID to associate each batch result with its video.
— data.videos[].video.{id,title,username,duration,video_post_time,thumbnail_url,play_url} Added Returns the video ID, title, creator username, duration, posting time, thumbnail, and playback URL.
— data.videos[].error.{code,message} Added If performance details cannot be returned for a video, read that video's error. Do not check only the top-level code for the entire request.
data.performance.intervals[].sales.breakdowns[] No corresponding field in the new batch details API; use Get Shop Video Product Performance List for product-level data Removed; migration to another API required The new batch details API returns only sales.overall. Query product details separately using GET /analytics/202509/shop_videos/{video_id}/products/performance and handle pagination.

Get Shop Video Performance Details → Get Shop Video Product Performance List

Previous Field / Parameter New Field / Migration Target Change Type Migration Notes
data.performance.intervals[].sales.breakdowns[].product_id data.products[].id Product identifier mapping across APIs Call the product performance list with the same video_id and query date range. The list returns product performance for the query period and does not provide daily intervals.
data.performance.intervals[].sales.breakdowns[].items_sold data.products[].units_sold Units sold field mapping across APIs Validate the metrics using the same video, product, and date range. The previous items_sold and new units_sold have different field names.
data.performance.intervals[].sales.breakdowns[].{gmv,gpm,customers,ctr,product_impressions,product_clicks} data.products[].{gmv,gpm,customers,ctr,product_impressions,product_clicks} Product metric mapping across APIs Metrics with the same names are available from the product performance list. In that list, gpm is GMV per 1,000 product impressions, and ctr is product clicks / product impressions. Align the granularity and metric definitions of the previous and new APIs during migration; numerical equivalence is not guaranteed.

Get Shop Video Product Performance List

Previous Field / Parameter New Field / Migration Target Change Type Migration Notes
— (new) data.products[].{ctr,customers,gpm,product_clicks,product_impressions} Product metrics added The existing gmv, units_sold, and daily_avg_buyers are retained. ctr is product clicks／product impressions, and gpm is calculated per thousand product impressions. customers does not replace daily average buyers.

Get Shop LIVE Performance Overview

Previous Field / Parameter New Field / Migration Target Change Type Migration Notes
Request parameter account_type: OFFICIAL_ACCOUNTS／MARKETING_ACCOUNTS Request parameter account_type: LINKED_ACCOUNTS Enum values changed The two previous enum values are no longer supported. Query linked accounts instead. ALL and AFFILIATE_ACCOUNTS are retained. Do not mix these values with the supported values for the LIVE list.
data.performance.intervals[].gmv (including amount and currency) data.performance.intervals[].live_gmv／live_indirect_gmv／live_attributed_gmv Previous field removed; separate GMV definitions introduced The new fields provide direct, indirect, and attributed LIVE GMV, respectively. Select a metric based on your analysis needs. No new field is stated to be numerically equivalent to the previous gmv.
data.performance.intervals[].sku_orders data.performance.intervals[].live_attributed_sku_orders Previous field removed; attribution definition changed The new field counts paid SKU orders attributed to LIVE. Update the metric name and definition.
data.performance.intervals[].items_sold data.performance.intervals[].live_attributed_items_sold Previous field removed; attribution definition changed The new field counts items sold attributed to LIVE. Do not simply rename it and append it to a historical series using the previous definition.
data.performance.intervals[].customers — Removed; no equivalent field This API does not provide a corresponding customer count field. Do not treat attributed_customers from the LIVE list as the overview customer count.
data.performance.intervals[].click_to_order_rate data.performance.intervals[].ctor_sku_order Previous field removed; conversion definition changed The new field is LIVE-attributed SKU orders／product clicks, returned as a raw decimal. This differs from the previous direct-order conversion definition.
data.performance.intervals[].click_through_rate data.performance.intervals[].live_ctr Previous field removed; denominator changed The previous field used product clicks／LIVE views. live_ctr uses product clicks／product impressions and returns a raw decimal. This is not an equivalent field rename.

Get Shop LIVE Performance List

Previous Field / Parameter New Field / Migration Target Change Type Migration Notes
Request parameter account_type: optional; supports ALL Request parameter account_type: required; ALL is no longer supported Required status and enum values changed Explicitly select OFFICIAL_ACCOUNTS, MARKETING_ACCOUNTS, or AFFILIATE_ACCOUNTS. Do not omit the parameter or pass ALL, and do not use LINKED_ACCOUNTS from the LIVE overview.
data.live_stream_sessions[].interaction_performance.{acu,pcu,viewers,views,product_impressions,product_clicks} data.live_stream_sessions[].traffic.{acu,pcu,viewers,views,product_impressions,product_clicks} Field paths changed Read the listed traffic metrics with unchanged names from traffic. interaction_performance continues to contain engagement metrics such as comments, likes, follows, and shares.
data.live_stream_sessions[].interaction_performance.avg_viewing_duration（String） data.live_stream_sessions[].traffic.avg_viewing_duration（Int64） Path and type changed Update JSON parsing to use an integer. The unit remains seconds. The new avg_viewing_duration_per_viewer is a different metric and must not be used interchangeably.
data.live_stream_sessions[].interaction_performance.click_through_rate data.live_stream_sessions[].traffic.ctr／traffic.live_ctr Previous field removed; select new ratio fields by definition The previous field used product clicks／views multiplied by 100. live_ctr uses product clicks／product impressions. Both new ctr and live_ctr return raw decimal strings. Review their definitions separately rather than carrying over previous values directly.
data.live_stream_sessions[].sales_performance.products_added data.live_stream_sessions[].traffic.products_added Field path changed Read the number of products added to the LIVE session from traffic.
data.live_stream_sessions[].sales_performance.different_products_sold data.live_stream_sessions[].sales_performance.products_sold Field name changed Read this as the number of distinct products sold. Do not confuse it with item quantities in items_sold／live_attributed_items_sold.
data.live_stream_sessions[].sales_performance.gmv (including amount and currency) data.live_stream_sessions[].sales_performance.live_gmv／live_indirect_gmv／live_attributed_gmv Previous field removed; separate GMV definitions introduced The new fields provide direct, indirect, and attributed GMV, respectively. Select the definition you need. No field is stated to be numerically equivalent to the previous gmv.
data.live_stream_sessions[].sales_performance.sku_orders data.live_stream_sessions[].sales_performance.live_attributed_sku_orders Previous field removed; attribution definition changed The new field counts paid SKU orders attributed to the individual LIVE session.
data.live_stream_sessions[].sales_performance.items_sold data.live_stream_sessions[].sales_performance.live_attributed_items_sold Previous field removed; attribution definition changed The new field counts items sold attributed to the individual LIVE session.
data.live_stream_sessions[].sales_performance.customers data.live_stream_sessions[].sales_performance.attributed_customers Previous field removed; customer attribution definition changed The previous field counted customers who placed orders directly in the LIVE session. The new field counts customers attributed to that LIVE session. This is not simply a rename.
data.live_stream_sessions[].sales_performance.click_to_order_rate data.live_stream_sessions[].traffic.ctor／traffic.ctor_sku_order Previous field removed; path, format, and metric selection changed ctor is the click-to-order conversion rate, returned as a raw decimal string. ctor_sku_order is explicitly defined as attributed SKU orders／product clicks. The previous field used a percentage. Update the display format and review the business definition.
data.live_stream_sessions[].sales_performance.24h_live_gmv (including amount and currency) — Removed; no confirmed equivalent field The new live_attributed_gmv is not an equivalent replacement for the previous 24-hour-window metric. Stop using the previous field mapping.
data.live_stream_sessions[].username data.live_stream_sessions[].creator.user_name Field name and path changed Read the creator username from the creator structure, which also provides author_type, creator_country, nick_name, and open_id.
